notes.title: A New Game Announcement - Wishlist Now!
notes.notes:
Hey there!

Today, I'm super excited to announce Without a Dawn, a Visual Novel with philosophical and psychological horror elements, coming on 19 May 2025. Without a Dawn is a dark tale of introspection and features a unique pseudo-ASCII art style I have carefully crafted over the past year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10370616/41798ff9beae1e1e3363d8c6ac5af9d4c2ea4907.gif[/img]

Check out the store page, and consider adding to your wishlist!
Thank you for your continuous support! :)

Jesse

notes.title: Update notes for May 20
notes.notes: The red "back" button in the options menu now takes you back to the level selection instead of quitting the application as it did previously. Hunting some achievements now should be more pleasant. Sorry it took this long! :)

notes.notes:
Hey guys,

As the title suggests, I've added Steam Trading Cards for Heal.

Cheers!

Jesse

notes.title: Heal: Console Edition is now available for consoles!
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

I've been working on a new, 2D horror game for the past... 8 months or so? The work is going great, and I'm excited to share more of it in the future. But meanwhile, I'm very excited to let you know that Heal is now available for consoles (Heal: Console Edition - PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox X/S, and Nintendo Switch). The console version is ported and published by Ratalaika Games, just like the DISTRAINT -series.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35324557/5c93fb8a094cfd61f90927ad4c80af0b785bf7f8.png[/img]

If you're curious about my new game, you can check my Twitter for more info/gifs.

Thanks for reading and have a great weekend! :)

Jesse

notes.title: Heal is coming April 10 - Please, consider adding to your wishlist!
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

I'm excited to tell you that Heal is coming April 10 for PC, Android, and iOS. I'm currently also looking to release on consoles as well, more info about this once I learn more.

I'd appreciate if you could add Heal to your wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1056610/Heal/
